==Description==
The '''Range Flag''' is one of the four rare [[Consumables|consumables]]. The '''Range Flag''' has a 2.78% (5.41% with [[VIP+]]) chance to be gotten from a [[Low Grade Crate]], a 6.15% (9.41% with [[VIP+]]) chance to be gotten from a [[Mid Grade Crate]] and a 22.03% (21.67% with [[VIP+]]) chance to be gotten from a [[High Grade Crate]].

Only up to three '''Range Flags''' can be used in a match by a single player. It has a 60 second cooldown, though when the match first starts the cooldown is set to 45 seconds. Its cooldown does not start until the '''Range Flag''' disappears.

==Usage==
When using the '''Range Flag''', a flag pole with a blue flag will appear, which can be placed on any part of the map. When placed down, it will give a 20% [[Range Buff]] to all towers in its 16 range for 45 seconds. This buff does not stack with other '''Range Flag's''' [[Range Buff]]s.

==Appearance==
The '''Range Flag''' is a blue flag with a long grey pole. The flag has a small white circle, with the range icon in front of the circle.

==Strategy==
*The [[Range Buff]] of the '''Range Flag''' cannot increase the range of the following towers:
**The [[Shotgunner]], as its bullets do not extend into the gained range.
**The circling range of the [[Pursuit]] and [[Ace Pilot]].
***The radius in which towers gain hidden detection from the [[Ace Pilot]] also cannot be increased.
***These towers' attack ranges will still be increased.
**The [[Gladiator]]; enemies will not be damaged in the gained range if it is a number beyond 6.
**The [[Slasher]].
**The [[Sledger]] will hit fewer enemies in its gained range.
**The chain range of the [[Electroshocker]].
***The attack range can still be increased.
**The deadzone ranges of towers like the [[Biologist]] and [[Engineer]].
**The sentry building range of the [[Engineer]].
**The explosion radius from [[Splash Damage|Splash Damage towers]] cannot be increased.
